import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from services.kr_market_backtest_trade_helpers import calculate_cumulative_trade_metrics, build_cumulative_trade_record, build_ticker_price_index
from services.kr_market_backtest_stats_helpers import calculate_jongga_backtest_stats
root=Path.cwd()
manifest=json.loads((root.parent/"evidence/review-input-v2.json").read_text())
mismatches=[]
for rel, expected in manifest["files"].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual != expected:
        mismatches.append((rel, expected, actual))
assert not mismatches, mismatches
raw=pd.DataFrame([{"date":"2026-02-21","ticker":"005930","high":109.0,"low":99.0,"close":108.0}])
before=raw.copy(deep=True)
idx=build_ticker_price_index(raw)
m=calculate_cumulative_trade_metrics(100.0,"2026-02-20",idx["005930"],target_price=109.0,stop_price=97.0)
assert (m["outcome"],m["roi"]) == ("WIN",9.0), m
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(raw,before)
summary=calculate_jongga_backtest_stats([], [{"date":"2026-02-20","signals":[{"stock_code":"005930","entry_price":100.0,"target_price":109.0,"stop_price":97.0}]}], {}, raw, price_index=idx)
trade=build_cumulative_trade_record({"stock_code":"005930","entry_price":100.0,"target_price":109.0,"stop_price":97.0},"2026-02-20",raw,price_index=idx)
assert summary["win_rate"] == 100.0 and trade["outcome"] == "WIN", (summary,trade)
code_only=calculate_jongga_backtest_stats([], [{"date":"2026-02-20","signals":[{"code":"005930","entry_price":100.0}]}], {}, raw, price_index=idx)
empty_ticker=build_cumulative_trade_record({"ticker":"","stock_code":"005930","entry_price":100.0},"2026-02-20",raw,price_index=idx)
print({"hashes":"match","exact":m,"summary":summary,"code_only_count":code_only["count"],"empty_ticker_trade":empty_ticker})
